verdicts.reason: Both use the same left-to-right banner layout. In both, the CTA 'Shop the Summer Line' wraps awkwardly onto two lines and a bokeh dot collides with 'Line'. A's SOLSTICE logo is jammed right up against the 'C' of the headline with no breathing room, but it is still readable. B's logo is shrunk so far that the sun mark and wordmark can't be read, so the brand is effectively lost at this size.
